name: Komatsushima (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Komatsushima city emblem in white: a ring enclosing a vertical bar and a small ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Komatsushima, a city in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in May 1934.

features.role: Komatsushima city emblem — a ring enclosing a vertical bar and a small ring, like a stylised character
